data.description: A parrot is a tamable passive mob that spawns in jungle biomes. Parrots imitate sounds of nearby monsters and can perch on the player's shoulders.

<p>A <b>parrot</b> is a <a href="/w/Tame" class="mw-redirect" title="Tame">tamable</a> <a href="/w/Passive_mob" class="mw-redirect" title="Passive mob">passive mob</a> that spawns in jungle <a href="/w/Biome" title="Biome">biomes</a>. Parrots imitate <a href="/w/Sound" title="Sound">sounds</a> of nearby <a href="/w/Monster" title="Monster">monsters</a> and can perch on the <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>'s shoulders.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Spawning">Spawning</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Parrot?section=1&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Spawning" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Parrot?action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section's source code: Spawning"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Parrots naturally spawn in groups of 1–2 in <a href="/w/Jungle" title="Jungle">jungles</a>, <a href="/w/Bamboo_jungle" class="mw-redirect" title="Bamboo jungle">bamboo jungles</a>, and <a href="/w/Sparse_jungle" class="mw-redirect" title="Sparse jungle">sparse jungles</a>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">BE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> above <a href="/w/Log" title="Log">logs</a>, <a href="/w/Leaves" title="Leaves">leaves</a>, <a href="/w/Grass_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Grass block">grass blocks</a>, or <a href="/w/Air" title="Air">air</a>.
</p><p>Unlike most passive mobs, parrots cannot be <a href="/w/Bred" class="mw-redirect" title="Bred">bred</a>.
</p>

<p><span class="animated"><span class="pixel-image animated-active xp-2" style="background-position:left center;background-size:16px 16px;padding-left:19px;background-repeat:no-repeat"></span><span class="pixel-image xp-6" style="background-position:left center;background-size:16px 16px;padding-left:19px;background-repeat:no-repeat"></span></span>1–3<span class="hidden-alt-text">XP</span> <a href="/w/Experience" title="Experience">experience</a> orbs are dropped when parrots are killed by a player or a tamed <a href="/w/Wolf" title="Wolf">wolf</a>.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Behavior">Behavior</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Parrot?section=4&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Behavior" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Parrot?action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section's source code: Behavior"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Parrots fly around idly under normal circumstances, landing frequently to rest.<sup id="cite_ref-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> They take interest in any nearby <a href="/w/Mob" title="Mob">mobs</a>, including those that are hostile to them, and follow them around closely. When attacked, they rapidly fly upward several blocks to flee.
</p><p>Parrots also flap their wings to <a href="/w/Swim" class="mw-redirect" title="Swim">swim</a>, slow their falls, and prevent <a href="/w/Fall_damage" class="mw-redirect" title="Fall damage">fall damage</a>.
</p><p>Parrots can be <a href="/w/Tame" class="mw-redirect" title="Tame">tamed</a> by feeding them <a href="/w/Wheat_seeds" class="mw-redirect" title="Wheat seeds">wheat seeds</a>, <a href="/w/Melon_seeds" class="mw-redirect" title="Melon seeds">melon seeds</a>, <a href="/w/Pumpkin_seeds" class="mw-redirect" title="Pumpkin seeds">pumpkin seeds</a>, <a href="/w/Beetroot_seeds" class="mw-redirect" title="Beetroot seeds">beetroot seeds</a>, <a href="/w/Torchflower_seeds" class="mw-redirect" title="Torchflower seeds">torchflower seeds</a>, or <a href="/w/Pitcher_Pod" title="Pitcher Pod">pitcher pods</a>. Each item fed has a <sup>1</sup>⁄<sub>10</sub> chance of successfully taming them. Once tamed, <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">interacting</span> with a parrot makes it sit down and stand up.
</p><p>Unless told to sit, a tamed parrot follows the <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a> and teleports if there is a distance of 12 blocks between it and the player.
</p><p>A <a href="/w/Death_message" class="mw-redirect" title="Death message">death message</a> is displayed to a parrot's owner upon its death. 
</p><p>Because a <a href="/w/Cookie" title="Cookie">cookie</a> contains <a href="/w/Cocoa_beans" class="mw-redirect" title="Cocoa beans">cocoa beans</a> (the main component of chocolate) and chocolate is toxic to real-life parrots, feeding a cookie to a parrot kills it. In <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, the parrot receives 2<sup>128</sup> (3.4028 x 10<sup>38</sup>) and emits <a href="/w/Poison" title="Poison">Poison</a> particles as it dies. In <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>, a cookie inflicts <a href="/w/Fatal_Poison" title="Fatal Poison">Fatal Poison</a> on the parrot, killing it after a few secionds.
</p><p>Unlike most <a href="/w/Animal" title="Animal">animal</a> mobs, parrots cannot <a href="/w/Breed" class="mw-redirect" title="Breed">breed</a> and baby parrots do not exist.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Sitting_on_a_shoulder">Sitting on a shoulder</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Parrot?section=5&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Sitting on a shoulder" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Parrot?action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section's source code: Sitting on a shoulder"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:Parrot_Shoulder.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Parrot_Shoulder.png/300px-Parrot_Shoulder.png?a4c61" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="300" height="256" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Parrot_Shoulder.png/600px-Parrot_Shoulder.png?a4c61 2x" data-file-width="837" data-file-height="714"></a><figcaption>A <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a> with a parrot on their shoulder.</figcaption></figure>
<p>A tamed parrot on the ground can be made to perch on its <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>'s shoulder by moving through the parrot. On its own, a tamed parrot can also fly to and perch on the player's shoulder, unless it has been told to sit. A player can have one parrot on each shoulder. Parrots always prefer a player's left shoulder first, if it is empty.
</p><p>in <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, a parrot dismounts its player when the player:
</p>
<ul><li>Lands on a higher surface (<sup>1</sup>⁄<sub>2</sub> block up or higher)</li>
<li>drops off a ledge of higher than <sup>3</sup>⁄<sub>4</sub> of a block</li>
<li>takes damage</li>
<li>touches <a href="/w/Water" title="Water">water</a></li>
<li>touches <a href="/w/Powder_snow" class="mw-redirect" title="Powder snow">powder snow</a></li>
<li>is in creative <a href="/w/Flying" title="Flying">flying</a> mode</li>
<li>starts gliding with an <a href="/w/Elytra" title="Elytra">elytra</a><sup id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>sleeps on a <a href="/w/Bed" title="Bed">bed</a></li>
<li>submerges the player's head in <a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">lava</a> (the parrot dismounts and burns even if the player has <a href="/w/Fire_Resistance" title="Fire Resistance">Fire Resistance</a>)</li></ul>
<p>Parrots on a shoulder always look in the same direction the player's head is looking.
</p><p>A parrot riding on an <a href="/w/Entity" title="Entity">entity</a> cannot take any <a href="/w/Damage" title="Damage">damage</a> (except <a href="/w/Void" title="Void">void</a> and <code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/kill" title="Commands/kill">kill</a></span></code>).‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">Bedrock Edition</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> 
</p><p>But it may get hurt as soon as it dismounts, as when dismounting a player submerged in <a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">lava</a>.
</p><p>A parrot sitting on the shoulder appears in the <a href="/w/Inventory" title="Inventory">inventory</a> interface.
</p><p>In <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>, a parrot sitting on a shoulder prevents the player from entering a <a href="/w/Nether_portal" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether portal">nether portal</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-3" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-3"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>If a player uses an <a href="/w/Ender_pearl" class="mw-redirect" title="Ender pearl">ender pearl</a> while parrots are on their shoulder, the parrots teleport with the player.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Imitating_sounds">Imitating sounds</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Parrot?section=6&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Imitating sounds" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Parrot?action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section's source code: Imitating sounds"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Parrots imitate the idle <a href="/w/Sound" title="Sound">sounds</a> of nearby <a href="/w/Monster" title="Monster">monsters</a> and in <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>, a few neutral <a href="/w/Animal" title="Animal">animals</a> as well; they have a detection range of 20 blocks. The sound produced by the parrots is the same sound as the mob being mimicked at a higher pitch, the same pitch as the mob's baby variant. Occasionally, a parrot may imitate sounds of mobs that are not in the area.<sup id="cite_ref-4" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-4"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>4<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>In <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>, they can also imitate neutral mobs such as <a href="/w/Endermen" class="mw-redirect" title="Endermen">endermen</a>, <a href="/w/Polar_bear" class="mw-redirect" title="Polar bear">polar bears</a>, <a href="/w/Wolves" class="mw-redirect" title="Wolves">wolves</a> and <a href="/w/Zombified_piglins" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombified piglins">zombified piglins</a>. In <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, they can also imitate <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a>, <a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">hoglins</a> and <a href="/w/Piglin_brute" class="mw-redirect" title="Piglin brute">piglin brutes</a>. 
</p><p>In <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, parrots attempt to imitate <a href="/w/Happy_ghast" class="mw-redirect" title="Happy ghast">happy ghasts</a>, but without using the corresponding sound event.
</p><p>Parrots don't imitate the sounds of <a href="/w/Skeleton_horse" class="mw-redirect" title="Skeleton horse">skeleton horses</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-skelly_5-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-skelly-5"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>5<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Dancing">Dancing</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Parrot?section=7&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Dancing" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Parrot?action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section's source code: Dancing"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Parrots dance near a <a href="/w/Jukebox" title="Jukebox">jukebox</a> if a <a href="/w/Music_disc" class="mw-redirect" title="Music disc">music disc</a> is inside it. Parrots even have the ability to dance while on a <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>'s shoulder.‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">BE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> This is a reference to the Party Parrot meme.<sup id="cite_ref-6" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-6"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>6<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> They stop dancing when the track ends.<sup id="cite_ref-7" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-7"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>7<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>The dancing radius is 3 blocks from the jukebox. If they dance and then fly beyond this radius, they stop dancing. A parrot does not dance if the music disc was inserted prior to it spawning, dismounting, or being within the 3 blocks range.<sup id="cite_ref-8" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-8"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>8<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>

</td></tr><tr>
<td>Later the same day, she tweets an image of Steve "the parrot king" carrying parrots on his shoulder.<sup id="cite_ref-15" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-15"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>11<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></td></tr><tr><th rowspan="1" colspan="7"><a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://twitter.com/MiaLem_n/status/846974672663130113">March 28, 2017</a></th>
<td>Maria tweets another image of parrots, showcasing their ability to fly and slowly drift downward.</td></tr><tr><th rowspan="1" colspan="7"><a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://twitter.com/MiaLem_n/status/847371388641923072">March 30, 2017</a></th>
<td>Shortly before the snapshot was released, Maria revealed that parrots are attracted to <a href="/w/Cookie" title="Cookie">cookies</a>. This is a reference to the popular phrase "Polly wants a cracker".<sup id="cite_ref-16" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-16"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>12<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> In real life, parrots should <i>not</i> be fed chocolate chip cookies, as chocolate is toxic to parrots.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<td>The right-click action has been changed: right-clicking on a tamed parrot now tells it to sit.
</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">
<td>Having a parrot sit on the <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>'s shoulders now require the player to walk through the parrot.
</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">
<td><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Dancing_Parrot_JE1.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Dancing_Parrot_JE1.gif/48px-Dancing_Parrot_JE1.gif?938dc" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="48" height="48" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Dancing_Parrot_JE1.gif/96px-Dancing_Parrot_JE1.gif?938dc 2x" data-file-width="800" data-file-height="800"></a></span> Parrots now dance and cycle through the variants if <a href="/w/Music" title="Music">music</a> is playing on a nearby <a href="/w/Jukebox" title="Jukebox">jukebox</a>.
</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">
<td>Parrots now make <a href="/w/Sound" title="Sound">sounds</a> when sitting on the <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>'s shoulders.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_17w15a" title="Java Edition 17w15a">17w15a</a></th>
<td><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Dancing_Red_Parrot.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Dancing_Red_Parrot.gif/48px-Dancing_Red_Parrot.gif?5c26f" decoding="async" dancing.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_17w16a" title="Java Edition 17w16a">17w16a</a></th>
<td>Parrots now dismount whenever the player is not touching the ground. This makes it impossible to keep the parrots on the shoulder while gliding.<sup id="cite_ref-17" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-17"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>13<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Previously they only dismounted when moving upwards.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th colspan="4" rowspan="2"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.12-pre3" title="Java Edition 1.12-pre3">pre3</a></th>
<td>Parrots are now tamed with <a href="/w/Seeds" class="mw-disambig" title="Seeds">seeds</a>, instead of <a href="/w/Cookie" title="Cookie">cookies</a>, after <a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://web.archive.org/web/20170518214733/https://www.reddit.com/r/Minecraft/comments/6b0fkh/dear_mojang_please_remove_feeding_chocolate_to/">a post on Reddit</a>.
</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">
<td>Attempting to feed <a href="/w/Cookie" title="Cookie">cookies</a> to a parrot now instantly kills the parrot, causing it to emit <a href="/w/Poison" title="Poison">poison</a> <a href="/w/Particle" class="mw-redirect" title="Particle">particles</a>. In an e-mail to <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motherboard_(website)" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:Motherboard (website)">Motherboard</a>, <a href="/w/Jens_Bergensten" title="Jens Bergensten">Jens Bergensten</a> explained: "Our reasoning for originally using cookies was twofold; it gave cookies a reason to exist within <i>Minecraft</i>, and it was a subtle reference to the Nirvana song 'Polly.' However, we didn't consider what the chocolate ingredient would mean to real life parrots!"<sup id="cite_ref-18" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-18"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>14<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.12-pre5" title="Java Edition 1.12-pre5">pre5</a></th>
<td>Killing a parrot by feeding it a <a href="/w/Cookie" title="Cookie">cookie</a> now counts as if the parrot was killed by the player who fed it. This affects <a href="/w/Death_messages" title="Death messages">death messages</a>, causes the parrot to drop <a href="/w/Experience" title="Experience">experience</a>, take knockback and causes the <a href="/w/Looting" title="Looting">looting</a> enchantment to take affect.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.12-pre6" title="Java Edition 1.12-pre6">pre6</a></th>
<td>Parrots no longer dismount the player when simply not touching the ground. Now the player needs to fall at least about 0.75 blocks.​<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><a href="/w/Special:TalkPage/Parrot" title="Special:TalkPage/Parrot"><span title="Check code" style="border-bottom: 1px dotted">more information needed</span></a></i>]</sup></td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.13" title="Java Edition 1.13">1.13</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_18w19a" title="Java Edition 18w19a">18w19a</a></th>
<td>Parrots now imitate <a href="/w/Phantom" title="Phantom">phantoms</a> and <a href="/w/Drowned" title="Drowned">drowned</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.14" title="Java Edition 1.14">1.14</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_19w11a" title="Java Edition 19w11a">19w11a</a></th>
<td>Parrots can now imitate <a href="/w/Ravager" title="Ravager">ravagers</a>, <a href="/w/Pillager" title="Pillager">pillagers</a> and <a href="/w/Panda" title="Panda">pandas</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.14.2" title="Java Edition 1.14.2">1.14.2</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.14.2-pre1" class="mw-redirect" title="Java Edition 1.14.2-pre1">pre1</a></th>
<td>Parrots no longer spawn on <a href="/w/Grass" class="mw-disambig" title="Grass">grass</a>, but on <a href="/w/Grass_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Grass block">grass blocks</a> instead.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="4" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.15" title="Java Edition 1.15">1.15</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_19w40a" title="Java Edition 19w40a">19w40a</a></th>
<td>Parrots can now sit on a <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>'s shoulder even while the player is riding something.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_19w41a" title="Java Edition 19w41a">19w41a</a></th>
<td>Parrots no longer imitate <a href="/w/Panda" title="Panda">pandas</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_19w44a" title="Java Edition 19w44a">19w44a</a></th>
<td>Parrots no longer imitate <a href="/w/Polar_bear" class="mw-redirect" title="Polar bear">polar bears</a>, <a href="/w/Wolves" class="mw-redirect" title="Wolves">wolves</a>, and <a href="/w/Zombie_pigmen" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombie pigmen">zombie pigmen</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_19w45a" title="Java Edition 19w45a">19w45a</a></th>
<td>Parrots no longer imitate <a href="/w/Endermen" class="mw-redirect" title="Endermen">endermen</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="2" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16" title="Java Edition 1.16">1.16</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="2"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_20w12a" title="Java Edition 20w12a">20w12a</a></th>
<td>Parrots now imitate hostile mobs less often.
</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">
<td>Parrots no longer imitate hostile mobs when the difficulty is on <a href="/w/Peaceful" class="mw-redirect" title="Peaceful">Peaceful</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.18" title="Java Edition 1.18">1.18</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.18-pre5" class="mw-redirect" title="Java Edition 1.18-pre5">pre5</a></th>
<td>The bottom texture of all parrots' wings has been flipped.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.19" title="Java Edition 1.19">1.19</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_Deep_Dark_Experimental_Snapshot_1" title="Java Edition Deep Dark Experimental Snapshot 1">Deep Dark Experimental Snapshot 1</a></th>
<td>Parrots can now imitate <a href="/w/Warden" title="Warden">wardens</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.19.4" title="Java Edition 1.19.4">1.19.4</a><div class="historytable-experiment"><div>Experiment</div></div><span><a href="/w/Trails_%26_Tales" title="Trails & Tales">Update 1.20</a></span></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.19.4-pre1" class="mw-redirect" title="Java Edition 1.19.4-pre1">pre1</a></th>
<td>Parrots can now be fed using <a href="/w/Torchflower_seeds" class="mw-redirect" title="Torchflower seeds">torchflower seeds</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-19" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-19"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>15<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.20" title="Java Edition 1.20">1.20</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_23w12a" title="Java Edition 23w12a">23w12a</a></th>
<td>Parrots can now be fed using <a href="/w/Pitcher_pod" class="mw-redirect" title="Pitcher pod">pitcher pods</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.20.5" title="Java Edition 1.20.5">1.20.5</a><div class="historytable-experiment"><div>Experiment</div></div><span><a href="/w/Tricky_Trials" title="Tricky Trials">Update 1.21</a></span></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_24w07a" title="Java Edition 24w07a">24w07a</a></th>
<td>Parrots can now imitate <a href="/w/Bogged" title="Bogged">bogged</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.20.5" title="Java Edition 1.20.5">1.20.5</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_24w11a" title="Java Edition 24w11a">24w11a</a></th>
<td>Adjusted their flying behavior to keep them from overshooting their position when flying up and down.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.21.2" title="Java Edition 1.21.2">1.21.2</a><div class="historytable-experiment"><div>Experiment</div></div><span><a href="/w/The_Garden_Awakens" title="The Garden Awakens">Winter Drop</a></span></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_24w40a" title="Java Edition 24w40a">24w40a</a></th>
<td>Parrots can now imitate <a href="/w/Creaking" title="Creaking">creakings</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.21.11" title="Java Edition 1.21.11">1.21.11</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Java_Edition_25w44a" title="Java Edition 25w44a">25w44a</a></th>
<td>Parrots can now imitate <a href="/w/Camel_husk" class="mw-redirect" title="Camel husk">camel husks</a>, <a href="/w/Parched" title="Parched">parched</a>, <a href="/w/Zombie_horse" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombie horse">zombie horses</a> and <a href="/w/Zombie_nautilus" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombie nautilus">zombie nautiluses</a>.</td></tr></tbody></table>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Trivia">Trivia</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Parrot?section=23&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Trivia" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Parrot?action=edit&section=23" title="Edit section's source code: Trivia"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<ul><li>Red parrots are based on the real-life <span class="plainlinks"><a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/scarlet_macaw">scarlet macaw</a></span> "with a little Minecraft twist".<sup id="cite_ref-20" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-20"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>16<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Similarly, blue parrots are based on <span class="plainlinks"><a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyacinth_macaw">hyacinth macaws</a></span>, cyan parrots are based on <span class="plainlinks"><a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blue-and-yellow_macaw">blue-and-yellow macaws</a></span>, green parrots are based on <span class="plainlinks"><a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black-billed_amazon">black-billed amazon parrots</a></span>,<sup id="cite_ref-21" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-21"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>17<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and gray parrots are based on <span class="plainlinks"><a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/cockatiel">cockatiels</a></span>.</li>
<li>The <a href="/w/Minecraft" title="Minecraft">Minecraft</a> team uses various party parrot emojis when communicating with each other on discord.<sup id="cite_ref-22" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-22"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>18<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>The <a href="/w/Advancement" title="Advancement">advancement</a> obtained for breeding two animals is called "The Parrots and the Bats", even though neither parrots nor bats can breed.</li>
<li>The parrot's dancing animation is based on the <a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/party-parrot">party parrot emojis</a>, that are in turn, based on the <a target="_blank" rel="nofollow noreferrer noopener" class="external text" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9T1vfsHYiKY%7CSirocco">kākāpō</a>.</li>
<li>The "idle6" sound of the parrot is the English word "hello".<sup id="cite_ref-23" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-23"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>19<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li></ul>
<p><span class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File"><span><audio id="mwe_player_454" preload="none" controls="" data-mw-tmh="" class="mw-file-element" width="300" style="width:300px;" playsinline="" data-durationhint="1" data-mwtitle="Parrot_idle6.ogg" data-mwprovider="local"><source src="/images/Parrot_idle6.ogg?72286" type="audio/ogg; codecs="vorbis""><source src="/images/transcoded/Parrot_idle6.ogg/Parrot_idle6.ogg.mp3?5e9ab" type="audio/mpeg"></audio></span></span>
</p>
<ul><li>The artist and modeller for parrots, <a href="/w/RazzleberryFox" class="mw-redirect" title="RazzleberryFox">RazzleberryFox</a>, originally designed ten parrots.<sup id="cite_ref-24" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-24"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>20<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li></ul>
